result:
Disk filled → db write failed → api killed itself, never came back.

Timeline (log is dated 2026-03-09):

- 03:05:00–03:12:48: `job=report-export` writes 40 × 512 MB CSVs (~20 GB) to `/var/lib/stockroom/exports/`, one every 12 s.
- 03:09:03: `disk /var/lib/stockroom at 91%`; 03:13:30: 99%.
- 03:14:00: `db: could not extend file "base/16384/2619": No space left on device` — db shares that volume with exports.
- 03:14:03: `api: transaction aborted, shutting down worker pool`; 03:14:06: `FATAL api: exiting (status 1)`.
- 03:16:00 onward: `proxy: upstream api refused connection` every 2 min, 67 times, last at 05:28:00. Log ends 05:29:57 with no api restart and no api request after 03:13:51 → still down at end of log, 2h15m+ outage.

Root cause: report-export, no size cap, same volume as db data. Fixing means freeing `/var/lib/stockroom/exports/` and restarting api; nothing in the log shows either happened.

Not the cause: `cache: slow command` WARNs (100–149 ms) run the whole log at a steady ~5 min cadence, before and after the crash. Proxy and web kept logging status=200 after the crash, so only api-backed routes failed.

Unknowns: the export job's source isn't in this repo (no match for `report-export` outside the log), so I can't say what triggered it or why it ran so large. Log dates are March 9, not last night (today is 2026-10-08) — if you meant a more recent outage, this file doesn't cover it.
